title.zh: 德意志银行计划在欧洲为机构客户提供比特币、以太币托管服务
title.en: Deutsche Bank plans bitcoin, ether custody for institutional clients in Europe

current_state.zh: 德意志银行计划在数周内推出面向机构客户的加密托管服务，初期支持比特币和以太币，后续增加法币与稳定币兑换、代币化存款和数字债券发行，并计划2027年拓展亚洲金融中心。
current_state.en: Deutsche Bank plans to launch crypto custody for institutional clients within weeks, initially supporting bitcoin and ether, with fiat-to-stablecoin conversion, tokenized deposits and digital bond issuance to follow, plus expansion into Asian financial hubs in 2027.
